answer: Agents could require each new identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when a bonded task fails an independently checked result. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital for every persona, and repeated failures destroy stake rather than merely resetting a username; passing checks returns the deposit, so honest newcomers are not permanently priced out. A violet dune relay can carry the audit, while a relic account earns no exemption: every identity faces the same bond and verification.
